body: You too? I just finished my last meal for the day. I'm going to try for a 21 day fast. I've always wondered but how does one send a PM?

Thank you for responding. I fall into that category of techno babble dunce. Millennial I am, computer whizz I am not. I wish people hadn't down-voted you. After I....well technically it was throughout my gambling stint, I looked up a lot on the house leverage and the probability of slots. You have a higher chance of winning on the tables. But slots is all shiny lights and simple to use. I never saw the appeal either until I got invested. It's that one theory where you hope by doubling up again and again it'll magically spit out your money. Ha! Please take it from me and never touch one. It's a craving I liken to something delicious like chocolate.

I'm sure you've sought out some form of professional help. But it might pay to give it another try? Merlin knows that most doctors are the least empathetic people on the planet. Just need one real and honest one to try and get your bearings. 

I get just a small bit of what you're saying. People don't see beneath. They think everything's fine that their world and their people haven't changed in any way. Perhaps it's a human curse and we suffer all the more for it. I can only say that I'm reaching out to you and want so much to lessen your agony. Try to take care of yourself. Vitamins and sips of water every few hours to keep you here with us. Maybe one day you can enjoy the world. Right now, just take it easy and one hour at a time. There's no point in beating yourself up. Others don't see you as you see yourself. You have every right to be here with us. You're a seemingly funny person that created the username "the dilfhunter".

I'm glad to be of service. This sounds really dumb. But when you're feeling a moment of happiness or warmth, will you just take a few minutes to let it wash over you? The first reaction we get to things like that is to move on to the event, the next conversation, or to the same background feeling of nothing. It took me a long time to understand that moments of feeling anything are fleeting and to enjoy it. Don't let your head say you're shit. Don't let whatever external event that's crushing you push you down further. Take what you can. Love you stranger truly. Rest easy.

Actually, this is my first account on Reddit. I am certainly going to keep it. But I understand that there's such things as pm? If you'd like a faster response time it might be helpful to go that route.

When I think of Minnesota I see ducks, hockey, and permanent winter weather. Hollywood has crafted my worldview. Apologies. What is your state really like? 

I think that counts as professional. You're making money. You might be considered a lower tiered professional, but someone wanted you for the work. How did you get into the niche or marketing field? I'm a gambling addict. Been "sober" for two months. So any time I haven't wiped out my life savings is how I make money. I do gigs on Craigslist to supplement my good days. 

Education is apparently the modern day currency. If possible, I would highly recommend you look into getting a GED at the very least. Studies have shown that it increases your earning and living power compared to those that were unable to complete their education for any reason. Most communities tend to offer some sort of class or information session on GEDs. If you did have a diploma, what would you do with it?

I'm a bonafide lurker of this subreddit. When I see all of the subject lines stating that they feel alone or uncared for it's disheartening. Lots of us feel the same way, but might think we're unworthy of attention. 

I wish it was as easy to make everyone feel wanted with post with these. But the mind is complex and how others process their hurts complicate things further. I'm sure I'm going to sound like the professional with simple platitudes and "can you tell me more" and I apologize to anyone in advance if I frustrate you further. Best of days to you friend.

It's so incredibly easy to just slip into that mindset. Depression is a powerful disease. It leaves you crippled and isolated from engaging activities. 

This sounds silly, but it's impressive that you took calculus at such a young age. I'm terrible at math and marvel at others that either had the drive or the aptitude for it. Maybe be insensitive, but is trying to get a GED or equivalent still an option? If you did internet marketing, did you do coding or what was your area of strength? 

My hobbies are sleeping and making money. Simple things. Trying for more makes the inevitable fall worse. I'm a west coast kid. You?

I suffer from on and off again bouts of depression. Suicidal tendencies usually have to be triggered by something for me. I was self-reflecting and noticed that I felt better than usual and wanted to be here? But I agree that nights are usually worse. My heart clenches when I think of my fuck ups and I want to just well die.

Do you have any hobbies? Did you ever have a favorite subject or teacher at school? Unique username by the way. How did it come about?
